reporting-org.narrative: CIVIL INITIATIVES FOR DEVELOPMENT AND PEACE INDIA

title.narrative: STITCH-India

description.narrative: As the Sustainable Textile Initiative: Together for Change (STITCH) consortium, we envision a global garment industry that contributes to an equal and just society by respecting human rights in the world of work. The global garment industry is fragmented and complex, involving many actors across the globe, with varying levels of power and influence. This activity relates to Cividep's work contributing to India under STITCH.

comment.narrative: Unfortunately due to political situation, the 2 policy changes (state rules under new labour code in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka states) have still not been achieved. On overachievement of judgement numbers: Multiple courts passed favourable judgements on labor laws, which have been counted here.

In India, slow legislative process, shrinking civic space, along with strict FCRA regulations on CSOs has led to a change of
approach of STITCH in India for the second half of the programme. STITCH teams in India will no longer conduct direct
lobbying and advocacy for change in laws and policy, instead they will focus on establishing multi-stakeholder structures
through which influencing can take place where appropriate and desired by stakeholders. Targets-have been decreased as
the programme is not contributing towards these policy changes anymore. Instead, the programme will carry out
influencing activities with influential stakeholders to create functional multi stakeholder dialogue platforms.
